pages.text: Hello, little one. I am Spottedleaf. Herbs grow in small patches in forests and plains, so keep your nose open as you walk. $(br2)Pick them gently. A herb taken carefully will always grow back.
pages.title: Finding Herbs

pages.text: Bring herbs to an $(l)Herb Rock$() to mix them into poultices and bundles. Store them in a $(l)Stone Cleft$() so they stay fresh. $(br2)A wise medicine cat collects herbs in greenleaf, before leaf-bare comes.
Dock leaves are the most common herb of all. Wrap other herbs in them, or chew them into a poultice for scratches and sore pads.
pages.title: Dock
